v4.6.88 — Bots keep only the stocks they know on account takeover

✨ NEW
• When a bot takes over an account, its startup cleanup now liquidates not just wrong-asset-class positions but also any STOCK that isn't in the bot's own universe — so it only keeps and trades the tickers it knows, and sells off whatever else was sitting in the account.

ℹ️ Note on running bots on ALPACA: a cloud Alpaca bot needs your Alpaca API keys synced to the server. If an Alpaca bot 'starts then stops', open Tools → ALPACA, add your key + secret and assign it to that bot's side, then start it again. (Your IBKR energy bot is running fine — it just has IBKR creds, not Alpaca.)

Update via the in-app banner.
